calls.reason: This is an open-ended forecast with no deadline. The evidence is mixed: compositionality gaps shrink with scale but persist (Khandelwal & Pavlick), scaling helps on controlled tasks (Schug et al.), and GPT-4.5 mixes scale with other changes. Nothing settles it.

Independent tests just before and after February 2024 show recurring failures: GPT-4 followed only about 77% of IFEval prompts in Nov 2023, and DALL-E 3 matched only about 12% of plain negation prompts in tests from Mar–Nov 2024. Both fit the claim that the systems were unreliable.
